prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
For new_screen changes (2 tests), no clear effect was seen in either test.
Evidence is still thin for adoption, new_flow, finish, home, choose_path, and sign_in changes, as only one test has been completed for each.
The choose_path and reorder change was helpful, winning Round 4 (+12.0% after noise correction).
The sign_in reorder change was harmful (-6.1% after noise correction) and was stopped early.
Predictions were too high for tests with no clear effect or negative results, but underpredicted the winning test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +0.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +12.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -1.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_screen: -3.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 89.4%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Grid Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a visual grid layout with clear character choice cards to streamline pet picking. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off to 60.9% and takes a median of 89 seconds, indicating users need a clearer, faster way to compare pets.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop System Tray Location Demo Screen: Insert a dedicated demo screen before completion showing users where their pet resides in the system tray. (why: Support receives multiple emails from users confused about how to hide, control, or find their pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [home, redesign] Generation Waiting Stage Progress Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a structured stage view featuring a real-time progress bar and rotating feature tips. (why: The waiting step has a very long mean duration of 2336 seconds, causing frustration when custom pet generation is slow.)
3: [choose_path, layout] Journey Path Selection Carousel Layout: Switch the choose path screen to a carousel layout so users can easily cycle through path options. (why: The mean time spent on choose_path is 514 seconds despite a median of 8 seconds, showing some users get stuck comparing options.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Official Seal Hint: Add an official seal hint and progress counter to the adoption certificate screen to encourage naming completion. (why: Adoption step drops from 72.9% to 60.9%, needing clearer guidance to help users finish certificate creation.)
5: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Completion Notification Option: Add a desktop notification prompt on the waiting screen so users get alerted when pet generation finishes. (why: Mean time spent on the waiting screen is 2336 seconds, indicating users switch windows while waiting and forget to return.)
6: [finish, hint] Desktop Interaction Controls Tip Banner: Display an explicit interaction hint banner on the final welcome screen explaining basic desktop shortcuts. (why: Support received 3 emails post-onboarding asking how to talk to, hide, or control their desktop pet.)
7: [sign_in, copy] Pet Sync Account Reassurance Banner: Update sign-in copy to explicitly inform users that signing in backs up their pet safely across sessions. (why: Support logged 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account protection reassurance critical.)

scores.note: Adoption step drops sharply to 60.9% with long duration, making visual grid redesign impactful despite UI cost.
Strong support evidence, but new_screen changes consistently failed or caused negative lift in previous tests.
Extremely high mean wait time at home step suggests progress clarity will help prevent drop-offs.
Choose_path already has high conversion (89.4%), but high mean time indicates stuck users; previous step changes were effective.
Low cost hint addition targeting steep drop-off at adoption step.
Directly addresses 2336s mean waiting time by allowing users to leave and return when generation completes.
Simple banner tip fixing support confusion without adding intrusive new screen.
8 support emails plus 72.9% sign_in conversion provide strong backing for low-cost copy reassurance.
